description: This file defines an authentication store using Zustand for state management, including login, logout, signup, and fetch user actions, with persistence in localStorage.

methods.name: setToken
methods.description: Sets the authentication token in the store

methods.name: setUser
methods.description: Sets the user information in the store

methods.name: logout
methods.description: Logs out the user by clearing token and user info, optionally calling backend logout endpoint

methods.name: login
methods.description: Performs login with email/username and password, updates store with token and user

methods.name: signup
methods.description: Performs user signup with email/username and password

methods.name: fetchMe
methods.description: Fetches current user info from backend if token exists
